source_note: Recovered from an existing capture (title_before.png) taken during 2026-07-04/05 hotkey-safety testing, not a fresh F10 press - promoted into the library on 2026-07-06 during the course-correction pass.
roi_reason: The right ~55% of this screen is a rotating/ambient background image unrelated to menu state - confirmed by comparing 5 separate captures of this identical menu, which hashed 39-66 bits apart at full-frame vs. 3-7 bits apart once cropped to this left column. Cropping to the static text column keeps the hash meaningful.
notes: Top-level main menu.
